qualifier: via CXCR4 and G beta-gamma/PI3K-gamma
name: Chemotactic GPCR signaling via CXCR4 and PI3K-gamma
rationale: All members concern G-protein-coupled signal transduction steering leukocyte/dendritic cell migration (Cdc42, PLC/PKC, homing); CXCR4, G beta-gamma/PI3K-gamma and prostaglandin E response separate it from confusables built on chemokine clusters, RAC/RHO GTPase cycles or T/mast cell chemotaxis.

qualifier: Lewis antigen oligosaccharide synthesis
name: Fucose metabolism and Lewis antigen oligosaccharide synthesis
rationale: Members cover fucose metabolism/catabolism and fucosylated oligosaccharide (Lewis blood group) biosynthesis, unlike confusables centred on N-glycan elongation, O-glycan and sialylation.

qualifier: with cristae and outer membrane organization
name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and cristae organization
rationale: All members concern targeting, import, processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins and mitochondrial membrane/cristae organization, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial calcium uptake, inner-membrane insertion for complex assembly, or oxidative phosphorylation.

qualifier: TCA intermediates and pyruvate, sodium-coupled
name: Sodium-coupled TCA-intermediate and pyruvate transport
rationale: Members are transport of succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, tricarboxylates and pyruvate via sodium-coupled carboxylate transporters (with proximal tubule development), distinct from confusables on monocarboxylate/lactate, organic cation and malate-aspartate shuttle transport.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
name: Dendritic cell IL-12-driven Th1 polarization and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members describe activated dendritic cell cytokine (IL-12, GM-CSF) production, MHC upregulation and Th1 differentiation with IFN-gamma production, whereas confusables centre on IFN-gamma receptor signaling and its negative regulation, Tregs or CD8 T cell proliferation.

qualifier: Fc-epsilon receptor calcium mobilization
name: Fc-epsilon receptor calcium mobilization in type I hypersensitivity
rationale: All three members concern IgE/FcERI-triggered calcium mobilization (including LAT2/NTAL) underlying type I hypersensitivity, unlike confusables on BCR signaling, eosinophils, mast cell degranulation regulation or histamine/eicosanoid receptors.

qualifier: with glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
name: Glycosphingolipid synthesis and inherited lipid-enzyme or transporter defects
rationale: Members combine glycosphingolipid/ganglioside/galactosylceramide biosynthesis with inherited defects of mostly lipid- and eicosanoid-handling CYPs and transporters (CYP1B1, CYP2U1, CYP7B1, TBXAS1, SLCO2A1, SLC33A1, ABCB6), which separates it from confusables on bile acid, cholesterol, GPI or fatty acid/eicosanoid synthesis.

qualifier: potassium channels (two-pore, KATP, Ca-activated)
name: Potassium channel control of resting membrane potential and cation homeostasis
rationale: Members are potassium channel families, P-type ATPases and regulation of Na/K/Mg homeostasis, resting potential and action potentials, distinct from confusables on cation-chloride cotransport, presynaptic potential, paracellular transport or smooth muscle contraction.

qualifier: with Golgi stack assembly and disassembly
name: COPI vesicle traffic and Golgi stack assembly and disassembly
rationale: Members cover COPI budding, intra-Golgi and Golgi-ER retrograde traffic together with Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly and positioning, which the confusables (COPI-independent, endosome-Golgi, tubulation) lack.

qualifier: brainstem neuronal migration and axon guidance
name: Brainstem development and hindbrain neuronal migration
rationale: All members concern hindbrain/brainstem (pons) development, cell differentiation, migration and branchiomotor axon guidance including brainstem respiratory control, distinct from cerebellar, cranial nerve, motor behaviour and spinal cord confusables.

qualifier: endonucleolytic cleavage of the tricistronic transcript
name: Nucleolar cleavage and processing of tricistronic pre-rRNA
rationale: Members are the ETS/ITS1/ITS2 cleavages, 5'-end processing and positive regulation of rRNA processing (with MYC targets), whereas confusables centre on RNA polymerase I/III transcription and rRNA expression control.

qualifier: L1CAM signaling
name: L1-mediated axon tract formation and cerebellar development
rationale: Members combine L1 signaling/recycling and commissural/corticospinal axon tract morphogenesis with cerebellar granule layer and Bergmann glia development and motor learning, which distinguishes it from forebrain, midbrain dopaminergic and hindbrain confusables.

qualifier: hydroxylation, hypusine and diphthamide on elongation factors
name: Protein hydroxylation and hypusine/diphthamide modification of elongation factors
rationale: Members are residue modifications (lysine/proline hydroxylation, histidine diphthamide, eIF5A hypusine) that support translation elongation, unlike confusables on tRNA modification, protein methylation or collagen crosslinking.

qualifier: cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and ISG output
name: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing driving type I interferon and ISG response
rationale: Members span cytosolic DNA/dsRNA sensing via helicases/IRF3 and the downstream interferon-alpha response (OAS, IP-10, activated DCs), whereas confusables focus on RIG-I/TRAF signaling, NF-kB and regulation of IFN production.

core: Nuclear noncoding RNA maturation and decay
qualifier: exosome surveillance, snoRNP/Cajal body and telomerase assembly
name: Nuclear exosome RNA surveillance, snoRNP and telomerase biogenesis
rationale: Members cover 3'-5' exosome trimming/decay of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA and CUTs, snoRNP/Cajal body localization, rRNA modification and telomerase assembly, distinct from confusables on splicing, mRNA export, NMD/ribosome quality control and Pol I/III transcription.

qualifier: mast cell activation and Fc-gamma phagocytosis
name: Fc receptor signaling in mast cell activation and phagocytosis
rationale: All members concern Fc-epsilon and Fc-gamma receptor signaling and its outcomes (mast cell degranulation, hypersensitivity, ADCC, phagocytic cup formation), unlike confusables on BCR signaling or SIRP/inhibitory immune regulation.

qualifier: E2F/MYC transcription and G2/M programme
name: E2F- and MYC-driven proliferation and G2/M cell cycle signature
rationale: Members are E2F/MYC transcriptional networks, G1/S and G2/M transition events and proliferating (stimulated CD4 T cell) cell cycle modules, whereas confusables emphasise RB/DREAM repression, replication origin licensing or p53 checkpoint arrest.

qualifier: neurotransmitter, incretin and fatty acid inputs
name: Neural, incretin and fatty acid modulation of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members describe adrenergic, cholinergic, GLP-1 and fatty acid control of insulin secretion plus glucagon secretion, distinct from confusables on beta cell identity, KATP channels, insulin processing and incretin synthesis.

qualifier: SMO activation and GLI transcription
name: Hedgehog reception, SMO activation and GLI-driven transcription
rationale: All members cover Hedgehog ligand-receptor engagement through SMO activation to GLI target transcription, whereas confusables concern neural plate/midline development or Hh ligand processing and secretion.

qualifier: apoptotic cells, oxidized lipoproteins and amyloid-beta
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells, lipoproteins and amyloid-beta
rationale: Members span scavenger receptor classes, efferocytosis, oxLDL/foam cell responses, amyloid-beta and immune complex clearance by microglia/macrophages, which confusables (hyaluronan, RAGE, lysosome, microglial proliferation) lack.

qualifier: polyadenylation, histone mRNA and deadenylation-dependent decay
name: mRNA 3'-end processing, polyadenylation and deadenylation-dependent decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, histone mRNA stem-loop processing, Pol II termination and deadenylation/decapping-driven mRNA decay, distinct from confusables on capping/splicing, ARE-binding protein stability control and nuclear exosome surveillance.

qualifier: dendritic cell and lymphocyte homing
name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell and leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokines/receptors and chemotaxis of dendritic, T, B, NK and mast cells, distinct from confusables on lymphoid organ development, S1P signaling and integrin-mediated adhesion.

Members are mostly heterogeneous untitled modules (chromatin, mitosis, RB/BCL2 survival, mitochondria, growth-factor braking) plus scattered transcription, ubiquitination and ribosome assembly terms with no single shared biological process.

qualifier: social interaction, sensorimotor gating and amygdala
name: Social behaviour and sensorimotor gating with amygdala development
rationale: Members concern higher behaviours relevant to neurodevelopmental disorders (social interaction, prepulse inhibition, psychomotor, touch and visual behaviour, MECP2-GABA, amygdala), distinct from confusables on locomotion, vocal learning, glycinergic transmission and presynaptic function.

qualifier: FGF23-Klotho and PTH phosphate regulation
name: FGF23-Klotho phosphate regulation of bone and dentin mineralization
rationale: Members link FGFR1c-Klotho/PTH signaling and phosphate response to positive bone mineralization, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption (with secretory protein phosphorylation), distinct from confusables on sodium-phosphate transporters, enamel and negative mineralization control.
